Module com.examplez.demo
Package com.examplez.demo.models

Class SudokuGame

java.lang.Object
com.examplez.demo.models.SudokuGame
public class SudokuGame extends Object
Game-logic model for a 6Ã—6 Sudoku puzzle.

Responsibilities of this class:

  • Generate a fully solved, randomised 6Ã—6 board using a backtracking algorithm.
  • Select an initial set of cells to reveal as starting clues.
  • Validate player moves against the standard Sudoku constraints (unique values per row, column, and 2Ã—3 sub-block).
  • Detect board completion.
  • Provide utility methods consumed by MainMenuController.

The grid follows the standard 6Ã—6 Sudoku layout with 2-row Ã— 3-column sub-blocks (six blocks in total).

  • Method Details

    • fillFullBoard

      public void fillFullBoard()
      Generates a fully solved, randomised Sudoku board in place.

      Delegates to the recursive solve(int, int) backtracking method starting at cell (0, 0). After this method returns the matrix is guaranteed to contain a valid, complete 6Ã—6 solution.

    • chooseCluesToShow

      public boolean[][] chooseCluesToShow()
      Produces a boolean mask that indicates which cells should be revealed to the player as the initial clues.

      The selection strategy guarantees exactly two revealed cells per 2Ã—3 sub-block by iterating over each sub-block and randomly picking cells until the per-block count reaches two. The resulting mask typically exposes 12 of 36 cells (one per block Ã— 6 blocks Ã— 2 per block).

      Returns:
      a 6Ã—6 boolean array; true at position [row][col] means that cell is a starting clue

    • giveClue

      public List<Integer> giveClue(javafx.scene.control.TextField[][] blocks)
      Returns the coordinates of the next cell that should be revealed as a hint to the player.

      Iterates the grid in row-major order and returns the first cell whose TextField is currently empty. The returned list always contains exactly two elements: [row, col].

      Parameters:
      blocks - the 6Ã—6 grid of TextField nodes representing the current UI state
      Returns:
      a List with two elements [row, col] identifying the first empty cell; an empty list if no empty cell exists

    • isPossibleGiveClue

      public boolean isPossibleGiveClue(boolean[][] matrixBools)
      Determines whether the player is still eligible to request additional clues.

      Clues are forbidden once 35 of the 36 cells are already correctly filled, ensuring the player must solve at least one cell themselves.

      Parameters:
      matrixBools - the 6Ã—6 state mask (true = cell is finalised)
      Returns:
      true if the player may still receive a clue; false if 35 or more cells are already filled

    • sameNumberInSameColumn

      public int sameNumberInSameColumn(String user_input, int column, int row, javafx.scene.control.TextField[][] blocks)
      Finds a conflicting cell in the same column as the cell being validated.

      Scans every row in column, comparing the text of each TextField to user_input, and skips the cell at row (the cell being entered).

      Parameters:
      user_input - the value being validated (a digit string 1â€“6)
      column - the zero-based column index of the cell being validated
      row - the zero-based row index of the cell being validated (excluded from the scan)
      blocks - the 6Ã—6 grid of TextField nodes
      Returns:
      the zero-based row index of the first conflicting cell in the column, or -1 if no conflict is found

      Returns:

    • sameNumberInSameBlock

      public List<Integer> sameNumberInSameBlock(String user_input, int column, int row, javafx.scene.control.TextField[][] blocks)
      Finds a conflicting cell within the 2Ã—3 sub-block that contains the cell being validated.

      The sub-block boundaries are derived as: startRow = (row/2)*2 and startCol = (column/3)*3. The cell at (row, column) itself is excluded from the scan.

      Parameters:
      user_input - the value being validated (a digit string 1â€“6)
      column - the zero-based column index of the cell being validated
      row - the zero-based row index of the cell being validated
      blocks - the 6Ã—6 grid of TextField nodes
      Returns:
      a List containing the [row, col] coordinates of the first conflicting cell in the sub-block; an empty list if no conflict is found

    • isTheSudokuCompleted

      public boolean isTheSudokuCompleted(boolean[][] matrixBools)
      Checks whether the Sudoku puzzle has been fully and correctly solved.

      The puzzle is considered complete when all 36 cells are marked as finalised in matrixBools (i.e., every cell holds a confirmed correct value).

      Parameters:
      matrixBools - the 6Ã—6 state mask (true = cell is finalised / correctly filled)
      Returns:
      true if all 36 cells are finalised; false otherwise

    • getCoordinatestextField

      public List<Integer> getCoordinatestextField(javafx.scene.control.TextField[][] blocks, javafx.scene.control.TextField textField)
      Resolves the grid coordinates of a given TextField within the board.

      Performs a linear search through blocks using reference equality (Objects.equals(java.lang.Object, java.lang.Object)) and returns the first match.

      Parameters:
      blocks - the 6Ã—6 grid of TextField nodes
      textField - the TextField whose position is sought
      Returns:
      a List containing exactly two elements: [row, col] of the matched field; an empty list if the field is not found in blocks

    • printBoard

      public void printBoard()
      Prints the current board state to System.out with visual dividers separating the 2Ã—3 sub-blocks.

      A horizontal line is printed between every pair of rows (every 2 rows) and a "| " separator is printed between every group of 3 columns, matching the standard 6Ã—6 Sudoku grid layout.
